scope.primary_question: How do repeated continuous capitulum image phenotypes align with abiotic environmental structure within and among source-assigned thistle taxa after preserving measurement, sampling and spatial uncertainty?
scope.biotic_scope: Pollinator filtering and other biotic mechanisms are outside the current estimand because no directly comparable global exposure layer is available. They may be discussed only as untested alternative mechanisms.
scope.causal_ceiling: Spatial association does not establish plasticity, selection, adaptation, mechanism, independent origin or convergence.

taxonomic_identity.master_rule: Retain every source taxon assignment and its provenance in the master ledger; never rewrite source records destructively.
taxonomic_identity.primary_ecology_requirement: Use only observations with a documented taxon concept adequate for the model. Unresolved or uncertain assignments remain in coverage accounting but do not silently enter taxon-level ecological inference.
taxonomic_identity.misidentification_boundary: Name resolution does not independently verify image identification. Residual source-identification error remains an explicit limitation.

sampling_and_replication.independence_rule: Multiple heads or photos must not receive independent observation weight merely because they are numerous.
sampling_and_replication.dependence_rule: Known shared photo IDs, exact bytes and decoded-pixel identities remain grouped in all splitting, resampling and inference.
sampling_and_replication.range_status: Attach versioned native, introduced and unresolved status before ecological fitting. Preserve all strata; do not use a destructive acquisition filter.
sampling_and_replication.spatial_rule: Preserve the unthinned master data. Thinning, weighting or spatial random effects are model views with saved membership, not source deletion.

measurement_uncertainty.general_rule: Measurement diagnostics are upstream inputs to ecological inference, not post-hoc defenses of selected associations.

orientation.stable_subset_thresholds: Freeze from image-only perturbation behavior before joining environmental outcomes; do not choose thresholds from precipitation results.
orientation.primary_reporting: Report the main orientation model together with a predeclared stable-measurement subset or explicit measurement-uncertainty propagation. The precipitation coefficient must not be promoted if its interpretation depends on unstable measurements.

colour.interpretation_rule: Chroma is one coordinate of colour, not a direct pale-dark scale and not an anthocyanin assay. Interpret environmental colour structure jointly with lightness and circular hue; closed colour-composition fractions remain one composition rather than independent traits.

outline_and_fine_geometry.interpretation_rule: Image geometry remains viewpoint- and resolution-dependent unless separately calibrated.

visible_variation.terminology: Do not call the combined quantity biological intraspecific variance. Report it as visible image-phenotype or image-observation variation unless a biological component is independently identified.
visible_variation.ecological_importance_rule: Ecological importance of the retained below-taxon image variation is a downstream hypothesis, not a result implied by its magnitude alone.

collinearity_before_fit.cohort_rule: Compute diagnostics on the exact model cohort, not on a different global table.

abiotic_environment.added_information_rule: The phrase 'added information beyond the climate core' is supported only by an explicit nested or otherwise formally comparable model test of the predeclared block against the same core model and cohort.
abiotic_environment.univariate_rule: Single-predictor atlas slopes may be retained as descriptive maps but are not evidence of independent environmental effects when predictors are correlated.

trait_structure.primary_logic: Test coherent trait-module or multivariate structure before treating every endpoint by predictor combination as an independent biological story.
trait_structure.endpoint_decomposition: Endpoint coefficients explain a supported module-level pattern; they do not replace the module-level test with significance hunting.
trait_structure.whole_capitulum: Retain a whole-capitulum multivariate summary to test whether modules collapse to one syndrome or remain multidimensional.

within_taxon.purpose: Estimate the pooled within-taxon abiotic association while allowing adequately sampled taxa to deviate without noisy unpooled slopes.

among_taxon.purpose: Estimate environmental sorting of taxon-level phenotype summaries on the declared ecological range scope.
among_taxon.phylogeny_role: Historical placement is a sensitivity on the same ecological model, not an independent evidence replication.

phylogenetic_sensitivity.interpretation_rule: If alternative placements have negligible leverage, report that directly. Do not strengthen a claim by counting near-identical placement fits as independent confirmations.

claim_language.rule: Functional precedent may motivate the next experiment but does not upgrade an observational association to adaptation or mechanism.

ecological_fit_allowed_only_after: native/introduced/unresolved range status join is versioned for applicable models
endpoint-specific measurement diagnostics and stable-or-error-aware analysis rules are frozen
exact model cohorts and hierarchy are saved
abiotic core and additional block definitions are frozen
within- and among-taxon model formulas are saved
multiplicity or multivariate testing families are saved
